en: I recently moved to this town.\pI hear that MR. FUJI's not from\nthese parts originally, either.
That's odd, MR. FUJI isn't here.\nWhere'd he go?
MR. FUJI had been praying alone\nfor CUBONE's mother.
This is really MR. FUJI's house.\pHe's really kind.\pHe looks after abandoned and\norphaned POKéMON.
It's so warm!\nPOKéMON are so nice to hug.

MR. FUJI: {PLAYER}…\pYour POKéDEX quest is one that
requires strong dedication.\pWithout deep love for POKéMON,
your quest may fail.\pI'm not sure if this will help you,
but I'd like you to have it.
{PLAYER} received a POKé FLUTE\nfrom MR. FUJI.
Upon hearing the POKé FLUTE,\nsleeping POKéMON will spring awake.\pTry using it on POKéMON that are\nsleeping obstacles.
You must make room for this!
MR. FUJI: Has my POKé FLUTE\nhelped you?
POKéMON FAN MAGAZINE\nMonthly Grand Prize Drawing!\pThe application form is…\pGone! It's been clipped out.\nSomeone must have applied already.
POKéMON magazines line the shelf.\pPOKéMON INSIDER…\pPOKéMON FAN…
